sentences.en: The nurses must see to the comfort of their patients.
sentences.zh: 护士必须照顾好病人的舒适。

sentences.en: Please accept what little comfort these words can give you.
sentences.zh: 请接受这几句能给你的少许安慰。

sentences.en: Little attention was paid to the comfort for the passengers.
sentences.zh: 乘客的舒适几乎没有得到关注。
